Chapter 933: Chapter 1 Beyond The Universe (Subscription Request)_2

Chapter 933: Chapter 1 Beyond the Universe (Subscription Request)_2

“Master has comprehended the Chaos Rule?” Even though he was already absolutely certain, the six-armed figure couldn’t help but ask.

“Fortuitously, I have.” Lin Yuan replied.

In fact, the Chaos Rule was not something that could be comprehended directly; to be accurate, it was birthed from myriad other rules, at least that was the path Lin Yuan took.

“Really comprehended it?” A tumultuous wave surged once again in the six-armed figure’s heart.

…

After dismissing the six-armed figure.

Lin Yuan began to observe the changes within himself.

The moment he comprehended the Chaos Rule in the Immortal Realm, Lin Yuan’s physical body, soul, spirit, and internal world all underwent substantial leaps in strength.

Now, back in his true form in the Main Universe, Lin Yuan similarly noticed changes in his physical body, Soul Body, and internal world.

The most notable was the internal world.

In the Immortal Realm, Lin Yuan’s internal world was only a little over two hundred million li in diameter, with no depth of heritage, and yet was able to experience a tenfold to a hundredfold surge.

The internal world of his true form in the Main Universe, with the Chaos Void Origin accumulated from breaking through to Level Eleven, began to terrifyingly and tremendously ascend after the integration of the Chaos Rule.

Before the eleventh traversal, Lin Yuan’s internal world was less than nine hundred billion li in diameter.

But now?

Boom—The internal world began to expand wildly, and a vast amount of the Chaos Void Origin immersed deep within was absorbed.

In just ten breaths.

The internal world expanded to reach nine trillion li in diameter.

Another ten breaths.

Twenty trillion li in diameter.

After another ten breaths.

Fifty trillion li in diameter.

It was only at this moment.

That the expansion of the internal world gradually slowed down.

“Fifty-one trillion li in diameter…”

Lin Yuan’s Consciousness Incarnation descended into his internal world, overlooking the vast expanse, and his heart couldn’t help but be filled with myriad emotions.

Fifty-one trillion li in diameter… In fact, it was already possible to use a different unit of measurement.

Fifty-one trillion li, about equal to two light-years.

That is to say, Lin Yuan’s internal world had reached a diameter of two light-years.

“Unfortunately, the enhancement to the essence of life from comprehending the Chaos Rule still cannot compare to the enhancement from breaking through to Level Twelve.” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Normally speaking, upon ultimately successful breakthrough to Level Eleven and stepping into Level Twelve, the internal world would explosively expand to several thousand light-years within a short time, transforming into an internal universe.

Following this, it would gradually reach tens to hundreds of thousands of light-years in diameter, which is the normal standard for Level Twelve ultimates.

Theoretically, the internal world of a Path Splitting Realm powerhouse at Level Twelve would be between one hundred thousand and one million light-years.

Yet at this moment, Lin Yuan’s internal world exploded to reach two light-years and then slowed down.

Of course, this doesn’t mean that stepping into Level Twelve is harder than comprehending the Chaos Rule.

On the contrary, the difficulty of comprehending the Chaos Rule is much higher than breaking through to Level Twelve, not to mention comprehending the Chaos Rule at Level Eleven.

Who knows how many peak sovereigns are unable to comprehend the Chaos Rule and thus cannot advance further.

Comprehending the Chaos Rule and stepping into Level Twelve focus on completely different aspects.

The former leans more towards skill, while the latter is purely about the level of life.

For example, a common individual who masters Grandmaster-level skills, no matter how much they can eat, can at most consume several tens of jin of food in one meal.

But a giant hundreds or thousands of meters tall can easily consume hundreds of tons of food.

This is the difference brought about by different levels of life.

…

“Although my internal world cannot compare to the ultimate of Level Twelve, I should be no weaker than those Level Twelve Ultimates within the universe.” Lin Yuan was very confident.

His internal world was his weak point.

In addition, his life’s hierarchical stage is not as high as the ultimate twelfth layer.

But in terms of comprehending cosmic rules, Lin Yuan actually surpasses all who are at the ultimate twelfth layer within the universe.

This is true for both the Seventh Realm of space-time and the Chaos Rule.

Secondly, regarding his physical body, when the “Xuanhuang Physique” is cultivated to a Level Eleven Perfect, it reaches the twelfth layer’s level. Now, having been nurtured by the Chaos Rule, it has been elevated even further.

There is no need to mention the strength of his soul will.

With a soul will index of forty million points, even if soul weaknesses exist, Lin Yuan can easily ward off other ultimate twelfth layer soul ultimates and psychic attacks.

“Twelfth layer…” Lin Yuan pondered for a moment, feeling the continuous spread of his inner world and the strength of his physical body, etc.

He decided to delay the assault on the twelfth layer.

At the ultimate time, he will once again withstand the infusion of the Chaos Void Origin. The stronger the physical body, the inner world, and the soul are at that time, the more Chaos Void Origin they can contain, and the greater the benefits gained.

Currently, Lin Yuan’s inner world is only two light-years in diameter. The benefits brought by the Chaos Rule have not yet been completely digested. If he waits a bit longer, the final size of the inner world could reach five or even ten light-years.

The capacity to contain the Chaos Void Origin within an inner world of five or ten light-years would not merely be three or five times that of the current two light-years but dozens of times the difference.

Lin Yuan naturally does not wish to give up such benefits.

“At most, several decades will be needed to reach perfection, and then I’ll assault the ultimate layer”

Lin Yuan made up his mind. Several decades were nothing to him at his current level of strength; in fact, whether or not he made the assault on the ultimate level did not make much difference.

Even without attempting the ultimate level, there is no twelfth layer existence in the Main Universe that can kill him.

…

Cosmic Starry Skies.

Lin Yuan’s figure appeared out of nowhere. This was his Taiyang Divine Spirit.

“The cosmic space-time…”

Lin Yuan looked deep into the distance, the comprehension of the Seventh Realm of space-time made his perception incredibly terrifying, reflecting the vast Cosmic Starry Skies and countless Spatial Layers in his mind.

“Is this the entire universe?” Lin Yuan was slightly shaken inside.

Although he could see through every detail of the Immortal Realm when he was there, now looking down upon the entire universe still stirred something within him; the scale of the Cosmic Starry Skies alone was a hundred times that of the Immortal Realm, with complexity a thousand-fold or even more.

“Are there dozens of places where space-time is completely locked down? Such that even I cannot perceive them in detail?” Lin Yuan discovered that the Cosmic Starry Skies still had secrets in front of him, and there were areas he had yet to explore.

“These dozens of places, do seven of them belong to crucial locations of human civilization?” Lin Yuan immediately understood in his heart.

Any pinnacle race has ancestral lands with rich backgrounds—places of lineage, like the clan stars of human civilization and the key locations in the forefront.

To prevent snooping by twelfth layer ultimates, these crucial ancestral lands naturally have numerous defenses in place.

“Hmm… the Insect Race has four… Ancestor Tianyu has five… the Yu Clan has eight…” Lin Yuan looked around in turn.

Lin Yuan didn’t forcefully probe these time-space lockdowns that eluded his perception but merely glanced at each from a distance and moved his gaze away.

“Hm? The Robber Clan…only one?” Lin Yuan’s expression was slightly surprised.

Among the cosmic pinnacle race powers, the Robber Clan is definitely the most mysterious and powerful, only rivalled by the Universe Clan at their peak.

It is said that the Robber Clan comes from the previous Cosmic Era and is targeted and suppressed by the cosmic will.

Yet, their power cannot be concealed; the two twelfth layer ultimates of the Robber Clan are already at the pinnacle of the Path Splitting Realm.

If they were not detested by the cosmic consciousness, the Robber Clan might not rule over the Ten Thousand Universe Races, but probably wouldn’t be far off.

However.

Even the Insect Race and the Tianyu Clan have several time-space locked ancestral lands, but the even more powerful Robber Clan only has one?

Lin Yuan’s gaze pierced through layer upon layer of space-time, looking deep into the Robber Clan’s territory.

Lin Yuan couldn’t feel anything specific about the Robber Clan’s crucial land; it looked completely ordinary, just a simple cabin.

But it was this very cabin that blocked Lin Yuan’s vision despite being in the Seventh Realm of space-time.

“I cannot feel any aura from this cabin whatsoever?” Lin Yuan observed closely. When facing the other pinnacle race’s crucial ancestral lands, even though he could not discern specifics, he could still infer some information.

But facing this cabin? There were no clues at all.

“Interesting…”

Curiosity sparked within Lin Yuan, and he began to approach the cabin slightly, attempting to observe it through different dimensions of space-time.

Rustle…

As Lin Yuan intensified his observation, the door of the cabin abruptly pushed open, and a figure shrouded in mist stepped out, “Who is spying on my Robber Clan’s ancestral land?”
